verdict.rationale: Aleph is an FP&A platform with documented versioned forecasts, scenario modeling and variance analysis (forecast vs. actuals), plus connectors for CRM and billing systems, so the parts for building and tracking a plan exist. However, unlike headcount planning, no dedicated revenue-planning feature built from pipeline or subscription data is documented. Missing for 10: an explicit revenue-planning module or workflow, documented pipeline/subscription-driven revenue modeling (e.g., bookings, ARR, churn drivers), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
